data: NVIDIA reported net income of $72.88 billion ($72,880 million) for fiscal 2025, the year ended January 26, 2025, up from $29.76 billion in fiscal 2024. Tesla reported net income of $3.855 billion ($3,855 million) for fiscal 2025, the year ended December 31, 2025, down from $7.153 billion in fiscal 2024. Of Tesla's total, $3.794 billion was attributable to common stockholders after noncontrolling interests. On those figures NVIDIA's net income is about 18.9 times Tesla's, or about 19.2 times if you use Tesla's net income attributable to common stockholders. The two fiscal years are not aligned: NVIDIA's fiscal 2025 ended in January 2025, while Tesla's ran through December 2025, so the periods overlap by only about one month.
